title: CFA® Level I Complete Course
shortDescription: Every Level I topic explained from first principles, with notes, quizzes, a large question bank and mock exams.
description: A complete, structured path through the CFA® Level I body of knowledge. Each lesson pairs a focused video lecture with concise notes, worked examples and an end-of-lesson quiz. The question bank, flashcards, formula library and timed mock exams turn understanding into exam-day speed and accuracy.
whoFor: Candidates registered (or planning to register) for the CFA® Level I exam
Finance and commerce graduates who want a rigorous foundation in investments
Working professionals moving into research, portfolio management or risk roles
Anyone who found the official reading dense and wants clear intuition first
outcomes: Solve time value of money, statistics and hypothesis-testing problems quickly and accurately
Read and analyse financial statements and spot low-quality reporting
Value equities, bonds and basic derivatives with confidence
Apply the Code and Standards to realistic ethical dilemmas
Build a disciplined study plan and test yourself under exam conditions

faq.q: Does this course replace the official curriculum?
faq.a: No. It is an independent prep course that explains the topics in plain language and gives you extensive original practice. Use it alongside the official curriculum provided with your exam registration.

faq.q: How long will it take to finish?
faq.a: Most candidates plan roughly 300 hours of study for Level I. The study planner turns your exam date and weekly hours into a week-by-week schedule.

faq.q: Are the practice questions official exam questions?
faq.a: No. Every question is written originally for this course in an exam-like style.

faq.q: Can I study on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. The platform is fully responsive and works on phones, tablets and laptops.

faq.q: What is the difference between Self-Study and Premium?
faq.a: Self-Study gives you all lectures, notes and practice tools. Premium adds instructor Q&A on every lesson, live doubt-clearing sessions and a completion certificate.
